name: C05 creation-field evidence
notes: Reviewed source summaries from the fixture provenance and preserved label observations. The controlled comparison makes no live web request.

evidence.summary: Heaven Hill markets Elijah Craig 18-Year-Old as an ongoing 90-proof single-barrel bourbon. The source identifies an 18-year age and 45% ABV but no exact barrel number.

results.title: Elijah Craig 18-Year-Old Single Barrel
results.description: Producer evidence for age, strength, and the generic single-barrel product.

evidence.query: Reviewed Mars Komagatake 2022 Edition creation fields
evidence.summary: Hombo identifies Single Malt Komagatake 2022 Edition as a 50% ABV annual release. Mars is the consumer brand, Komagatake is the stable expression, and Mars Shinshu is the historical name of the established Komagatake distillery.

results.title: MARS Single Malt Komagatake 2022 Edition
results.description: Producer evidence for expression, edition, release year, and strength.

evidence.query: Reviewed Willett Family Estate barrel 4769 label fields
evidence.summary: The preserved label identifies Willett Family Estate Bottled Single Barrel Bourbon, aged five years, hand bottled from barrel 4769 at 64.2% ABV. The barrel number distinguishes this exact-cask release.

results.title: Willett Family Estate barrel 4769 label
results.description: Preserved label evidence for the exact cask, age, and strength.

evidence.query: Reviewed Midwinter Night's Dram Act 12 Scene 9 label fields
evidence.summary: The preserved bottle label identifies High West A Midwinter Night's Dram Act 12 Scene 9 at 49.3% ABV. The local Act 12 candidate does not include the complete scene identity.

results.title: High West Act 12 Scene 9 label
results.description: Preserved source label for the complete edition and strength.

evidence.summary: The official product identifies Watchpost Whiskey as an American blended whiskey at 42.5% ABV. Eight years describes one Westland component, not the complete blend, so the Bottle has no supported stated age.

results.title: Watchpost Whiskey
results.description: Producer evidence for the Bottle name, category, strength, and component-age distinction.

evidence.query: Source title for Cadboll Estate Batch 2
evidence.summary: The source title identifies Glenmorangie The Cadboll Estate Batch 2 as a 15-year-old single malt. It does not supply an ABV or release year.

results.title: Glenmorangie The Cadboll Estate Batch 2 15-year-old
results.description: Synthetic title evidence for the ordinary creation control.
